material_coverage_findings.locator: 1H Motor Voter Information and 1J Organ and Tissue Donation
material_coverage_findings.finding: The selected application section contains voter-registration and voluntary donor-choice rules that have no accepted knowledge facts. These choices apply to first-time applications even though military renewal/live-online rules were scoped out.

proposed_statements.statement: Voter registration is offered when applying for a Nebraska license or State ID Card.
A permit, license or State ID holder aged sixteen or older may make an organ-and-tissue donation declaration through the DMV.
A heart donor symbol appears on the document only when the holder chooses organ or tissue donation.
For a donor between sixteen and eighteen, available parents or legal adult guardians may amend the minor’s donation decision.
Donor status remains in place when the driving or identification document expires.
A donation declared through a permit, license, State ID, donor card or donor registry cannot be rescinded after the donor’s death.
A deceased donor’s family is included in the donation process but does not need to authorize the donation.

material_coverage_findings.disposition: coverage_gap_for_mapped_application_section; no claim these carry official exam weights
